extension.description: Unique extension which will be validated at the location level.

state.description:
State of the extension after it was validated.
 * `VALID` - Extension is valid.
 * `DUPLICATE` - Extension already assigned to another group.
 * `DUPLICATE_IN_LIST` - Extension already exists in the request body and was already verified.
 * `INVALID` - Extension is invalid.

errorCode.description: Error code of the state in case extension is not valid.

message.example: [Error 9495] The extension is not available. It is already assigned as a Call Park Extension: 407721.
message.description: Message assigned to the error code.
